title: Percy Jackson's parents
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Percy Jackson character profile
text: Percy Jackson is a Greek demigod. His parents are Poseidon and Sally Jackson.

title: Percy Jackson's roles at camp and in the series
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Percy Jackson character profile
text: Percy narrates Percy Jackson and the Olympians. He leads Poseidon's cabin and previously served as a praetor of Camp Jupiter's Twelfth Legion.

title: Annabeth Chase's family and relationship
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Annabeth Chase character profile
text: Annabeth Chase is Athena's demigod daughter and Percy Jackson's girlfriend. She is a central character in both Percy Jackson and the Olympians and The Heroes of Olympus.

title: Poseidon, sea god and Percy's father
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Poseidon character profile
text: Poseidon is the deity of the sea and the father of Percy Jackson.

title: Athena's domains and daughter
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Athena character profile
text: Athena is associated with wisdom, warfare, and practical arts. Annabeth Chase is her daughter.

title: Percy's water abilities
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Camp Half Blood Cabins, Poseidon section
text: The Poseidon cabin description identifies Percy Jackson as able to breathe beneath water and, at times, control it.

title: Annabeth and Athena's cabin
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Camp Half Blood Cabins, Athena section
text: Annabeth Chase leads Cabin Six at Camp Half-Blood. Athena's children are valued for their planning and advice.

title: Hermes cabin and unclaimed campers
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Camp Half Blood Cabins, Hermes section
text: The Hermes cabin formerly housed campers whose divine parents had not claimed them. Hermes welcomes guests as the god of travelers.

title: Hera's unoccupied cabin
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Camp Half Blood Cabins, Hera section
text: Hera's cabin at Camp Half-Blood honors her but has no occupants. The resource explains that she has children only with Zeus.

title: The Lightning Thief: the stolen bolt
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Percy Jackson and the Olympians, The Lightning Thief synopsis
text: In The Lightning Thief, twelve-year-old Percy travels across the United States to find the thief of Zeus's master bolt. A satyr and Athena's daughter accompany him.

title: The Sea of Monsters: saving the camp
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Percy Jackson and the Olympians, The Sea of Monsters synopsis
text: Poisoning of Thalia's tree weakens Camp Half-Blood's magical defenses in The Sea of Monsters. Percy and his friends sail to find an item that can save the camp; Percy also needs to rescue Grover.

title: The Battle of the Labyrinth: protecting Camp Half-Blood
reference: Rick Riordan official website — Percy Jackson and the Olympians, The Battle of the Labyrinth synopsis
text: In The Battle of the Labyrinth, Kronos's forces threaten to invade Camp Half-Blood. Percy and his friends enter the underground Labyrinth in an attempt to stop them.
